subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, and should that be default, opt-in, or deferred behind the Slack-safe progress visibility work?
rationale: Current main has the plumbing for tool events and native status, but deciding what tool detail is safe to expose in Slack threads is a product/security choice rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sanitized native statuses
options.body: Implement short tool-family labels from `onToolStart` without raw args, commands, paths, or file names, aligned with the Slack-safe visibility policy.

options.title: Keep native status generic
options.body: Treat the merged rotating loading messages as the intended native Slack status UX and leave per-tool detail in draft previews or explicit status reactions only.

options.title: Defer behind safe visibility
options.body: Block this issue on the Slack-safe progress visibility mode so native status inherits the same disclosure controls as progress previews and task cards.

recommendation.title: Sanitized native statuses
recommendation.body: Implement short tool-family labels from `onToolStart` without raw args, commands, paths, or file names, aligned with the Slack-safe visibility policy.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the latest merged native Slack status default decision and is the clearest routing owner for whether per-tool native status should become part of that UX.
